title: Specimen catalogues
purpose: Review the lists specimens are registered with: participants, collections, specimen types, specimen containers and units of amount.
summary: The lists specimens are registered with: participants, collections, specimen types, specimen containers and units of amount.

tasks.title: Find an entry
steps: Choose the tab, then type part of the code or name in [[Search]] and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Add an entry
steps: Admin and manager: select the New button on the tab, for example [[New participant]].

tasks.title: Change or retire an entry
steps: Select its code, change it or clear Active, and give a reason.

good_to_know: Participants are codes only. No names or other identifying text are stored.
Entries are never deleted. Inactive entries stay on existing specimens but are not offered for new ones.
Specimen containers are vessels such as cryovials, not the box grids under Storage.

items.label: Participants
items.description: Coded participant identifiers such as P-000123. Only the code is stored; no names or other identifying text.

items.label: Collections
items.description: Named groups of specimens, such as a study or batch, by code and name.

items.label: Specimen types
items.description: What the material is (for example plasma), by code and name.

items.label: Specimen containers
items.description: The vessel a specimen is held in (for example a 2 mL cryovial), with an optional nominal capacity. This is not the same as the box grids under Storage.

items.label: Units
items.description: Units of amount with their dimension (volume, mass or count) and whether fractions are allowed.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: All roles can read the lists and export them. Only admin and manager can add or change entries: for them the code opens the edit form and New participant, New collection, New specimen type, New specimen container or New unit appears; everyone else sees the code as plain text.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the code (participants) or part of the code or name (other tabs), ignoring capitals. The Status filter defaults to Active and inactive; choose Active or Inactive. Click Code or Name to sort (default by code); choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page.

items.label: Code
items.description: Identifier used on specimens and in imports. Always shown.

items.label: Name
items.description: Descriptive name; not on the Participants tab.

items.label: Nominal capacity
items.description: Specimen containers only: the vessel's stated capacity with its unit, or a dash. It is a label of the vessel, not an amount on a specimen.

items.label: Dimension, Amounts
items.description: Units only: Volume, Mass or Count, and Fractional or Whole numbers.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active entries are offered when registering. Inactive entries stay on existing specimens but are not offered for new ones.

sections.title: Export
paragraphs: Export CSV downloads the entries that match the current search, filters and sort, with the columns the tab holds and yes or no for flags. At most 10,000 rows can be exported. Each download is logged with who made it, how many rows and the filters used. An empty catalogue says “Nothing in this catalogue yet”; managers are offered the New button.
